condition: Using diameter as radius, or taking a square root before isolating r².

condition: Adding a missing lid or confusing surface area with capacity.

task: Predict the effect of scaling
formula: Cylinder V ∝ r²h; sphere V ∝ r³. With h fixed, r × k gives V × k².
condition: Cylinder height fixed: radius ×k means volume ×k². Sphere: volume ×k³.

condition: Adding a base at a hemisphere–cylinder join.
